job.job_description:
Must Have Skills:



Hands-on experience with AWS Bedrock, Python FastAPI, Kafka, Java Spring Boot, Snowflake, SQL.
Strong knowledge of LLMs, RAG architecture, and multi-agent frameworks.



Good to Have Skills:



Knowledge on Core Python
Knowledge on Cloud platforms, GraphQL



Responsibilities or Expectations from the Role:



Design and implement agentic AI solutions using AWS Bedrock, including Agents, Knowledge Bases, and Guardrails.
Build serverless architectures with AWS Lambda, Step Functions, and EventBridge for AI agent workflows.
Develop prompt engineering strategies (chain-of-thought, tree-of-thought, React) for multi-step reasoning.
Integrate LangChain or Bedrock AgentCore frameworks for orchestration.
Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) workflows and knowledge bases.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable AI solutions.
